WORM'S-EYE-UP-THE-TITAN — camera flat on the baseplate aimed steeply up the brick titan's full height, two pilot-minifigs dwarfed at its feet, the greebled chest-plate blotting the sky.
MECH-VS-MECH-CLASH-BETWEEN — camera low between two opposing brick mechs, their weapon-arms locked in collision forming a violent diagonal X, shattered tile-debris exploding at the contact-point.

COCKPIT-CANOPY-REVEAL — camera tight on the open trans-neon-green canopy, pilot-minifig gripping greebled control-stubs inside, the shoulder-armor framing the intimate human-scale moment against the titan's bulk.

HANGAR-GANTRY-SIDE — camera at mid-gantry elevation shooting the mech in full side-profile, crew-minifigs on three staggered maintenance platforms wielding tool-parts, fuel-hose Technic tubes snaking down.
OVER-THE-SHOULDER-FROM-BEHIND — camera at the mech's armored shoulder looking past its cannon-arm toward a distant brick enemy, the scratched back-plate filling the foreground with war-worn texture.
AERIAL-BATTLEFIELD-DOWN — camera high overhead looking down as the mech strides across a shattered brick battlefield, rubble craters and tiny tank-units showing its overwhelming scale from above.
LOW-THREE-QUARTER-HERO-POSE — camera low at a forward three-quarter angle catching the mech in a planted combat-stance, its silhouette dynamic, the raised missile-arm reading with maximum weight.

FOOT-LEVEL-STOMP — camera at baseplate-level beside the descending armored foot, cotton-cloud debris and scattered minifig-scale rubble-tiles bursting upward toward the lens, a fleeing soldier-minifig mid-sprint.
DUTCH-ANGLE-ACTION — camera canted hard left on the charging mech, the tilted frame amplifying its forward momentum, a cannon-flash trans-orange stud bursting from its shoulder-mounted artillery.
SCALE-WITH-TINY-PILOTS-BELOW — camera mid-height with the full brick mech dominating the frame and a five-figure pilot-crew clustered at the ankle, the contrast crushing any doubt about its enormity.
BETWEEN-THE-LEGS-UPWARD — camera on the ground centered between the mech's planted legs, shooting steeply up through its Technic-pinned hip-joint toward the towering torso above, pure scale-vertigo.
MECH-FIST-PUNCH-TOWARD-LENS — camera low directly in front of the mech as a greebled fist thrusts forward, the knuckle-armor filling the foreground, enemy-mech wreckage collapsing in the background.
HANGAR-BAY-ENTRY-WIDE — camera at the far end of a brick hangar shooting the mech silhouetted in the massive bay-door opening, backlit by exterior light, crew-minifigs scattering below its frame.

COCKPIT-INTERIOR-OUTWARD — camera inside the open canopy looking outward past the pilot's helmet and control-panel greebling onto the battlefield stretching below, the mech's chest-armor framing the war-zone view.
SHOULDER-CANNON-LOCK-ON — camera tight alongside the shoulder-mounted brick cannon as it aims, the barrel leading the eye toward a distant target, the mech's head and torso anchoring the rear.

CRASH-LANDING-IMPACT — camera at knee-level as the mech lands hard, both fists planted on broken brick terrain, dust-cotton billowing forward, the stressed leg-joints and scarred shin-plates dominating close.

MECH-BACK-REACTOR-GLOW — camera behind and low aimed at the mech's back-mounted reactor-block, trans-yellow stud-lights glowing hot, exhaust-vents detailed, the battlefield visible distantly beneath the retreating frame.

TIGHT-ON-THE-WEAPON-ARM — camera mid-height locked onto the extended weapon-arm, blade-attachment or rifle-brick leading the eye, the mech's torso and inactive arm receding into soft-focus brick background.

UPWARD-TORSO-SPIRAL — camera low and slightly behind, tilted upward along the mech's rotating cannon-turret as it traverses, greebled exhaust-vents and antenna-arrays spiraling toward the frame's top edge.

COCKPIT-POV-OUTWARD — camera positioned inside the trans-clear canopy looking out through the mech's eye-slits, the brick battlefield stretching ahead, control-panel studs visible in the foreground blur.
WEAPON-BARREL-END-ON — camera placed directly in front of the mech's extended cannon-barrel looking back, the barrel-bore filling center-frame, the mech's full armored body receding behind it.
GANTRY-CRANE-OVER — camera suspended above the hangar floor on the overhead crane-rail, shooting down at the mech being fitted with a fresh missile-shoulder-pack by ladder-mounted crew minifigs.
KNEE-LEVEL-CHARGE — camera at knee-height as the mech drives forward across rubble, its advancing thigh-armor blotting the upper frame, shattered brick-tiles cascading toward the lens underfoot.
SHADOW-FALL-REVEAL — camera low on the ground behind cowering minifig civilians as the mech's enormous brick silhouette falls across them, only its legs and waist visible above-frame.
MECH-HEAD-CLOSE-SENSOR — camera tight on the mech's angular sensor-cluster head, chin-mounted autocannon centered, a burning brick outpost reflected in the trans-red eye-strip at mid-frame.

BACK-MOUNTED-THRUSTER-LOW — camera low-rear at ankle-level looking up the mech's spine toward its back-thruster array, the heat-exhaust cone of orange-plate bricks directed upward at the frame's apex.

DUAL-MECH-SCALE-PARADE — camera at hip-height shooting two allied brick mechs marching in formation, their combined mass filling the frame edge-to-edge, minifig ground crew dwarfed between their legs.
RUBBLE-PILE-PEEK — camera tucked behind a collapsed brick-wall foreground, the mech looming through a ragged gap in the debris, its weapon-arm silhouetted against an orange-plate fire glow.
COCKPIT-HATCH-LADDER-CLIMB — camera side-close on the mech's chest as a pilot minifig climbs the access-ladder rungs toward the open canopy hatch, the mech's full towering height implied above.
MECH-SHOULDER-ARTILLERY-FIRE — camera behind the mech's left shoulder as it unleashes a volley, spent brick-shell casings ejecting past the lens, the target terrain erupting in the far-ground.
GROUND-BETWEEN-THE-FEET — camera centered on the brick ground directly between the mech's planted feet, shooting upward through the gap, the entire undercarriage and torso framing the sky above.
HANGAR-DOOR-EMERGENCE — camera outside the blast-door threshold shooting inward as the mech steps through the opening, the massive door-frame dwarfing the machine, crew scattering to each side.

TILTED-MECH-DUEL-WIDE — camera low and dutch-tilted capturing both dueling mechs at opposing frame corners, their exchanged beam-weapons crossing diagonally center-frame, a shattered city-block between them.

HANGAR-GANTRY-SIDE-ELEVATION — camera at upper-gantry height shooting the mech in strict side profile as wrench-wielding crew-minifigs crowd three separate service-platforms, fuel-cables draping the shoulder armor.

UNDER-THE-RAISED-FIST — camera directly below the mech's clenched brick fist punching skyward, the arm greebling and exhaust-ports rushing away from the lens, the ground-minifigs tiny specks far below.

CORRIDOR-BREACH-PUSH — camera inside a crumbling brick corridor as the mech forces its armored shoulder through the wall, plate-pieces flying inward toward the lens, the scale crushing the narrow passageway.

REFLECTED-IN-THE-VISOR — camera extremely close on the mech's trans-red sensor-visor, the smoldering brick battlefield reflected across its curved surface, the scratched armor surrounding it telling the whole war story.

TWIN-CANNONS-FIRING-FORWARD — camera low and tight between the mech's two raised shoulder-cannon barrels aimed directly at the lens, the barrel greebling rushing toward us, the torso receding behind in forced perspective.

DEBRIS-FIELD-CRAWL — camera at rubble-tile level with the mech wading knee-deep through a shattered brick structure, its legs pushing whole plate-sections aside, the destruction stretching across the entire foreground.

LAUNCH-BAY-LOW-ANGLE — camera at pit-floor level inside a launch-bay trench as the mech stands astride the channel above, its legs forming a colossal arch, a lone technician-minifig below checking clearance.

COCKPIT-POV-LOOKING-OUT — camera positioned at pilot-eye-level inside the open cockpit looking outward past the instrument-greebling and canopy lip at the battlefield spread beyond the mech's weapon-arm below.

SHOULDER-TO-SHOULDER-ADVANCE — camera low between two allied brick mechs advancing side by side, their armored shoulders nearly touching above the lens, the battlefield horizon visible only as a narrow gap ahead.

GRAPPLE-LOCK-CLOSE — camera wedged tight between two mechs locked in a grapple, their brick fingers interlocked and torsos grinding together, the violent mechanical pressure readable in every stressed joint and strut.

BATTLEFIELD-SILHOUETTE-DUSK — camera at low three-quarter angle with the mech backlit against a glowing orange brick-plate sunset, the entire silhouette in deep shadow, only weapon-outlines and antenna-tips catching the light.

MAINTENANCE-CRANE-ABOVE — camera at crane-hook height looking down over the mech's shoulders and head as a gantry-claw grips the detached weapon-arm above, crew-minifigs swarming the scaffolding on all sides below.

CHARGE-PAST-CAMERA — camera planted at knee-height as the mech runs directly past the lens, the near leg blurred and enormous, the far leg mid-stride, debris-tiles skipping across the brick ground ahead.

WEAPON-ARM-EXTENDED-LOW — camera below and ahead of the mech's fully extended weapon-arm pointing toward the lens, the barrel greebling massive in the foreground, the mech-body receding in dramatic forced perspective behind.

WRECKAGE-RISE — camera low among scattered brick-mech wreckage parts as the intact mech rises into frame above, its damaged armor catching the light, a victorious pilot-minifig visible through the cracked canopy above.

REACTOR-CORE-REVEAL — camera close on the mech's open chest-plate exposing the glowing trans-yellow reactor-core bricks inside, the armored ribs of the torso framing the power-source, a minifig engineer reaching in carefully.

WORM'S-EYY-UP-THE-TITAN — camera pinned to the hangar-bay floor shooting steeply upward past the mech's stomping legs, gantry scaffolding converging overhead, three minifig pilots dwarfed at its heel-plates emphasizing crushing titan scale.
